Name: OLED-Dynamic-HUD
Author: Yuczysko
Description:
[i]Description[/i]
A SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley 1.6 that keeps the vanilla HUD hidden by default to reduce [b]OLED burn-in[/b], then reveals it on cursor proximity, keybinds, or game events.
[i]
Installation instructions[/i]
1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4+ for Stardew Valley 1.6.
2. Download the release zip and unzip into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[i]Main features[/i]
- HUD hidden by default with smooth fade-in / fade-out
- Reveal on mouse hover, hold key, gamepad, or game events (damage, tool use, time milestones, etc.)
- [b]Cinema mode[/b] — hard-hide HUD chrome for a clean screen
- [b]Idle / AFK mode[/b] — auto-hide after inactivity (desk OLED AFK)
- Location [b]presets [/b][i](Farm / Mine / Exploration / Town / Custom) [/i]with an in-game radial picker
- In-game [b]F8 settings[/b] menu [i](vanilla Options-style)[/i] plus optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] registration
- Soft bridges for [b][i]UI Info Suite 2[/i][/b] and [i][b]I[/b][/i][b][i]t’s Stardew Time[/i][/b] so companion chrome sleeps with the HUD
- Public read-only API for other mods (`OledDynamicHudApi`)

[i]Requirements[/i]
- [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b]
- [b]SMAPI 4+[/b]

Shout outs
- Thanks to [b][i]Pathoschild[/i][/b] for SMAPI and ModBuildConfig
- Thanks to [b][i]Annosz[/i][/b] for UI Info Suite 2 (`Annosz.UiInfoSuite2`)
- Thanks to [b][i]CabooseSage[/i][/b] for It’s Stardew Time (`Cabbose.Sage.TimeMaster.ItsStardewTime`)
- Thanks to [b][i]spacechase0[/i][/b] for Generic Mod Config Menu (`spacechase0.GenericModConfigMenu`)
